text:
2026-08-03 review adds four Phase A beads (A7-A10), all landed and closed: observation reportedCluster lost on the wire, script-batch accounting probe escaping the exchange budget, submission/cancellation claims not recovered on a typed Left, and workload logs created with the site umask in four of five script builders. Each shipped with a test demonstrated RED against its parent commit, per this epic's completion rule.

Two of the four confirm the epic's own thesis that a green suite is not evidence. A7 and A9 were invisible by construction: A7 because the omitted codec field carries a default of None, so the decoder compiled under -Werror and only the local path kept the value; A9 because the store stub in the suite always accepted, so the rejection branch was never taken.

Sequencing note for Phase E: A7 fixed one field on one codec and deliberately did not open the broader property-law work, which stays behind P7.2 per the 2026-07-28 decision on P6f.12. A7 is evidence for that decision rather than against it -- an unpinned hand-written codec silently dropped a field that a case class, a parser, and a suite all agreed existed.

Verification boundary for these four: sbt -batch test => 405 tests, 0 failed, Scala 3.3.8, JDK 25 host. scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck pass. Not performed: real Slurm site contact, 3.8.4 lane, fault injection beyond the two injected store/runner stubs.

Note this epic's body still records the pre-P8.B4 verification boundary (305 tests, Scala 3.7.4). The compiler line is stale: ADR 0001 was amended 2026-07-30 under P8.B4 to make 3.3.8 LTS the publication baseline. Several current-state documents were never updated to match, and P6f.18's acceptance still asks for the reverse. That propagation is the next queued item.
